verdict.rationale: OpenHands explicitly supports creating automations/workflows triggered by schedules or webhook events, integrating with Slack, GitHub, Linear, etc., plus concrete prebuilt background automations (bug-watch, PR label review, workflow-fix, security remediation, Slack mention monitor) that run autonomously without manual invocation.
